name: Telecommunications Center
use: Campus data center and telecom demarcation (1st floor), IT offices and conference rooms (2nd floor)

bb.title: UNH Telecommunications Building (Charters Brothers project listing)

verdict: A small 2020 data-centre and IT building; every detail comes from an unopened contractor listing.
notes: Every fact here is UNCONFIRMED: the only source (The Blue Book project listing, cited by the old row) returns 403 to curl and WebFetch, so I saw its content only as search-engine excerpts: 7,200 sq ft, Charters Brothers CM, Oakpoint Associates architect, completed Jan 2020, data center on floor 1 with Liebert heat-pump HVAC and halon suppression, IT offices on floor 2. A separate USNH Enterprise Technology Data Center "on the outer edge of the UNH campus" exists (https://www.usnh.edu/ibeamnh/services/co-location-application-hosting); I could not tell if it is the same building. No photos. Location unverified.
